task_description: Summarise the given news article in English.

axes.name: sentence_length
axes.description: 문장 길이의 평균 단어 수를 나타냅니다.

values.instruction: Write sentences that are short and concise, typically under 20 words each.
Write sentences that are relatively long, averaging around 25 to 30 words each.

axes.name: detail_density
axes.description: 문장당 포함된 단어 수와 전체 답변 길이 대비 내용 비율을 나타냅니다.

values.instruction: Provide brief summaries with fewer details and lower word count relative to the input.
Include a moderate amount of detail, balancing summary and explanation with about 100 words.
Include many details and explanations, resulting in longer and denser summaries.

axes.name: hedging_frequency
axes.description: 답변 내에서 불확실성이나 추정 표현(hedges)의 사용 빈도를 나타냅니다.

values.instruction: Use few or no hedging expressions; state facts confidently and directly.
Use frequent hedging expressions to indicate uncertainty or possibility.
Write the entire summary as a single paragraph without line breaks.
Divide the summary into multiple paragraphs to separate ideas or topics.
